entries.zh: 亲密之友；交情深厚（亲厚）
entries.en: intimate friends; close and deep friendship

entries.zh: 心膂之交（如心与脊骨般紧要亲信的朋友）〔原件有疑：膂或脊〕
entries.en: bosom friends, as of the heart and vitals (heart and spine)
entries.notes: 汉栏有 [疑:膂/脊]，且 M 栏多出第三音节（疑另有“脊”字），栏间不完全一致。

entries.zh: 知己（深知我心之友）
entries.en: bosom friend, one who truly knows one
entries.notes: 汉栏有 [疑:巳/己]（形近致疑）；西语 gloss “mijomo” 释义不明，释义以汉栏“知己”为准。

entries.zh: 说合（居中调和，使两人结好）；撮合成谊
entries.en: to reconcile and bring people together in friendship; to make friends by mediation

entries.zh: 相聚结交（“佐会”犹言做会：结伴聚会以敦友谊）
entries.en: to join together in friendship; to assemble as companions

entries.zh: 契合（意愿相投、志趣吻合之友）
entries.en: friends who accord in their good desires; whose wishes agree
entries.notes: 西语缩写 b.no 依推断展开为 bueno（好），故降为中等置信。

entries.zh: 得心（知心：能洞悉对方心意的朋友）
entries.en: friends who know one's heart

entries.zh: 反面（反目、翻脸绝交）
entries.en: to fall out and break off friendship; to turn against

entries.zh: 反骨（背叛君上、心怀贰志的臣属）
entries.en: treacherous friends or retainers of the king or other superiors who prove faithless; a “rebel bone”, disloyal disposition

entries.zh: 恩情（彼此施恩、情谊深重的厚交）
entries.en: kindness and affection between close friends; mutual favor and gratitude

entries.zh: 恩爱（相亲相爱、情爱深笃）
entries.en: devoted mutual love and affection

entries.zh: 人情意好（其人情意良善，堪称完美之友）
entries.en: a perfect friend — one whose feelings and intentions are good
entries.notes: 首字栏间不一致：H/M 栏作“人”，R 栏对音 xīn 作“心”，取 H 栏汉字。

entries.zh: 私和（私下和睦、彼此客气相待）
entries.en: amiable, courteous friends; privately harmonious

entries.zh: 相同心腹（心腹相同、习气相近的莫逆之交）
entries.en: friends of one heart and vitals; kindred spirits, much alike in customs

entries.zh: 得宠（受君王或上位者宠信之亲信；亦指最受疼爱的女伴/爱侣）
entries.en: to win favor; a favorite (privado) of the king, or a most cherished (female) friend

entries.zh: 家和（一家人之间和睦友爱）
entries.en: amity and harmony among the members of one family

entries.zh: 准和（准许和好、允诺缔结交谊）
entries.en: to consent to friendship; to approve a reconciliation

entries.zh: 两人相倚（二人互相依倚、彼此为友）
entries.en: friendship between two persons who lean on each other
entries.notes: M 栏末音节声标记 T99（污損难辨），释义主要依 L/H 栏推断。

entries.zh: 相放伴（互相作伴，帮对方分担劳苦之友）
entries.en: friends who keep each other company and help bear one another's toils

entries.zh: 磨（研磨、磨碎）
entries.en: to grind; to mill

entries.zh: 磨利（磨使锋利）〔原件有疑：中字陽或傷〕
entries.en: to sharpen; to grind to an edge
entries.notes: 汉栏有 [疑:陽/傷]，中字不决；据西语 amolar 与“利”字释为磨利。
